intro.title: Hello, I'm Lain
intro.desc:
Robot development enthusiast, Junior Year Student.
Interning at a Humanoid Robot Company.
Focus on MCU & Linux development, Motion Control, RL, and Perception.
Email: lain-ego@qq.com

event1.title: Open Source SliverWolf Desktop Quadruped
event1.desc: Released SliverWolf, a desktop-level serial quadruped robot featuring voice control and robotic arm collaborative capabilities.

event2.title: 2024 ROBOCON National Competition
event2.desc: Developed the embedded control system for the R1 robot based on FreeRTOS, achieving ±5mm positioning accuracy, ball launching, and gripper functionalities.

event3.title: 2024 Fujian Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest
event3.desc: Developed an autonomous driving car system based on the MSPM0G3507, qualifying for the provincial testing stage.

event4.title: Fujian Intelligent Marine Equipment Design Competition
event4.desc: Led the development of the control system for a buoyancy-controlled multi-DOF lobster underwater robot, winning the Grand Prize.

event5.title: 2024 World Marine Equipment Conference
event5.desc: Represented Fujian University of Technology as an exhibitor, showcasing the bionic Boston Lobster robot; covered by media outlets including Xinhua News Agency.

event6.title: 2025 ROBOCON National Competition
event6.desc: Responsible for full-stack R&D of the legged robot. Ranked 30th nationally in the Sprint Race, 31st in the Obstacle Race, and 34th in the Cross-Country Race, securing three National Second Prizes.

event7.title: 2025 National Undergraduate Electronics Design Contest
event7.desc: Responsible for the hardware design and fabrication of the power meter for an automatic ranging system, winning the National Second Prize.

event8.title: Open Source BRS Parallel Quadruped Robot
event8.desc: Open-sourced the mechanical structure and control code of the BRS parallel quadruped robot on GitHub.

event9.title: Internship at Gaoqing Electromechanical
event9.desc: Responsible for mechanical design, control algorithm development, and system integration testing for the HTDW4438 bionic quadruped robot (both open-source and commercial versions).
